replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I've always found math interesting but not my strength. Math helps me understand patterns in biology and physics, but I prefer intuitive learning over rote memorization.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, anxiety pops up when problems feel abstract or complex. It’s a challenge but I’ve learned to reframe anxiety as curiosity.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried a free AI tool last year for basic algebra. It helped with simple equations but struggled with advanced topics. Since I have no formal education, I found it frustrating when it didn’t explain concepts clearly. I prefer hands-on practice with nature and biology.
